full_page.content:
Page 24 Cont.
Feb. 7 Mrs. Dorothy Kruszka - 30 - husband and 2 small children depend- ing on her threatened with amputation of breast ...... Enrolled To-day 5.
John Flynn - 64 - nervous an inclined to palsey.
Page 25
Feb. 7 Mrs. Celia Hathaway - 52 - has husband and 6 boys depending on her. Gladys Stringer - 40 - threatening tumor on the breast ..... fears operation.
Carl Louis Mergaert - 19 - in "service" two years. Mother recently broke her arm and asks for prayers for speedy return of her son - only support
Catherine Schulte - 70 - missed step and broke ankle.
Mrs. Rose Dominic - 49 - peculiar ailment on her neck. Drs. fear cancer ....
13 Tho's Sokolowski - 1 yr. old - has grown so very little - now only 13 1bs.
13 Ruth M. Burnham - 31 - has hardly any memory - fine healthy looking - has never made her confession or Holy Com'n - Modest and likes to pray in Church .... Father takes all to holy Mass etc, but never prays seemingly
Page 26 Feb. 13 Burnham Cont. - Mother enrolls whole family To-day - perpet'ly 25.00. Raymond Patnande - 16 - Ep. Fits - not often but too often ....
15
15 Mrs. Marg. Doherty - 34 - peculiar disease - vascular-defused - "no remedy known for its cure."
16 Robert Diamond - 38 - Electrition fell 45 feet from a scafold break- ing his back, ankles and 12 ribs. This happened on Thanksgiving-Day. 1943 - still badly paralyzed.
Lawrence Callison - 49 - of Sidney Nova Scotia - now in Mount Royal, Ca. - very peculiar tumor on Chest .... has wife and five small child- ren depending on him ..... March 4 reported - ". .. had operation March Ist, Drs. hopeless .... "
